hero.caption: The Caferağa Medresseh in Istanbul was built in 1559 by Sinan by orders of Caferağa, a eunuch during the reign of Sultan Süleyman the Magnificent. Today it houses a handicrafts centre and a restaurant This  panoramic image was created with Autostitch (stitched images may differ from reality).
